lastCompletedStory.title: Add fail-loud preflight as a plain failing test per hard dependency

openQuestions: pgrep is classified hard-dependency by default (same reasoning as tmux/git/jq/uuidgen/bun) even though it comes from the same procps package as ps and is therefore also absent in the oven/bun:1.2-slim worker container. Only ps has a documented narrow host-vs-container rationale (test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts). If a later migration story finds pgrep needs the same legitimate-environmental carve-out, update its DEP_METADATA entry in test/helpers/test-deps.ts rather than defaulting other unclassified binaries to environmental.
nextStoryContext: test/preflight-deps.test.ts adds one real-probe fail-loud test per hard dependency (tmux, git, jq, pgrep, uuidgen, bun; ps excluded, legitimate-environmental) plus DI-seam behavioral coverage (AC4), all against depPreflight from test/helpers/test-deps.ts (US-001). Verified live: full-PATH `bun test` on this branch = 5702 pass / 0 fail / exit 0 / no skip-summary-line, vs. a live `git worktree add` of main = 5665 pass / 0 fail / exit 0 (338 files) -- floor cleared. Real PATH-surgery (`env -i ... PATH="$BUNBIN:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"`, tmux absent) = exit 1, tmux test fails naming the binary + `brew install tmux`/`apt-get install tmux`. Inertness control (same env -i, tmux dir prepended) matched full-PATH exactly (5702/0/exit0) on the 2nd of 2 runs; the 1st run had a single unrelated timing flake in test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (recycle watcher e2e) under full-suite CPU contention, reproduced-clean both standalone and on immediate re-run at full suite scope -- pre-existing test, not touched by this story, not a defect in the preflight file itself. test-deps.ts's DI seam (US-001) remains unmigrated at the ~46 scattered Bun.which/spawnSync call sites across test/**; that migration is still the next open story, now with test/preflight-deps.test.ts as a second reference consumer of the public surface (DepName, DepClassification, DepInfo, getDepInfo, isAvailable, WAIVER_ENV_VAR, parseWaivers, isWaived, depPreflight).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bun test's only documented exit guarantee is non-zero exit when any test fails, and that neither test-file collection order nor [test].preload abort semantics are documented -- validating AC13's route rationale (plain failing test per dependency, no preload-throw, no filename-sort-order reliance, no bunfig.toml).
